caption: Four small drill blocks march north in open ground, ordered 6 ticks apart. The input script samples state on every tick 0-239 (960 unit rows), so the state-transcript comment now shows one table whose middle rows are replaced by a marker naming the omitted ticks. Rendered the old way (one table per tick), the same transcript's table alone is about 117,000 characters, past GitHub's 65,536-character comment cap, which GitHub rejects, failing the whole Demo video job.
